lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in approximate vertical columns and horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The centroids form a structured, quasi-rectilinear grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to form distinct anchor nodes at the points of intersection.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the dorsal side and significant shadowing on the ventral side.
